ModMetaData.name: No Burn Metal
ModMetaData.author: Unon
ModMetaData.description:
Just making all the metalic lookin' things non-flammable, don't mind me.
NEW IN 1.9: MOD SETTINGS (1.6+) Options > Mod Settings > No Burn Metal. Flip things on or off one item at a time. - ON = No Burn (Metal). OFF = Yes Burn. - The metals this mod has always covered start ON. - Metals from mods it doesn't know about show up too, but start OFF until you flip them. - Items that already don't burn (Plasteel, Jade, Uranium) aren't listed, there's nothing to toggle. They were born fireproof. Show-offs.
NO LONGER FLAMMABLE - Steel, Silver, Gold, Power Conduits (Waterproof too!), Power Switches
SUPPORTED MODDED METALS [MODDED] - Expanded Materials - Metals (1.4 OR 1.5+) - Different versions have different metals, but have no fear! No Burn Metal is here.
[MODDED] - Alpha Animals - Sky Steel
[MODDED] - Vanilla Factions Expanded - Classical - Bronze
[MODDED] - Medieval Overhaul - Iron
[MODDED] - Cupro's Alloys (Continued) - Far too many to list.
[MODDED] - More Useful Materials - Carbon Fiber Composite, Heavy DU-Composite Steel, and any other metals it adds
COMPATIBILITY - Safe to add or remove mid-save. - The settings menu is 1.6+. Older versions still get the plain old always-on patches. - Still burning? On 1.9 or higher, check the settings, the item may be switched off. On older versions, load this AFTER all the mods it patches.
Expanded Materials - Metals patch done by Dr_Zhivago
